question: What is declared at the end of the eight Mahadevas?
premises: At the end of eight Mahadevas, eight yoga is declared.
Thus it is lord of Uma.
inference: At the end of the eight Mahadevas, the eight yoga is declared, and Shrikantha, lord of Uma, is declared there.
plain_english: At the end of the eight Mahadevas, the eight yoga is declared here; there Shrikantha, lord of Uma, is declared.
